rules.statement: A decree-holder of a different Court can claim concurrence in the proceeds realized under a writ of execution issued by another Court, provided they have obtained their decree and applied for execution prior to the realization of assets.
rules.supporting_quote: "I think that no violence will be done to the provision of section 352 if we read the expression 'for execution of decrees' as meaning 'for satisfaction of decrees,' which would include the case of application for payment of money realized by one Court in satisfaction of decrees of other Courts."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 352 of the Civil Procedure Code, and section 350 of the Civil Procedure Code
